encode_sentences_LaserEncoderPipeline: use LaserEncoderPipeline to tokenize and encode a list of sentences into multilingual embeddings
initialize_SentenceEncoder: create a SentenceEncoder from a model path to encode pre-tokenized sentences into embeddings
initialize_encoder_function: call initialize_encoder to download and load a LASER2 or LASER3 model for a given language
forward_LaserLstmEncoder: run the LaserLstmEncoder forward pass to get sentence embeddings from token tensors and sequence lengths
forward_LaserTransformerEncoder: run the LaserTransformerEncoder forward pass to get sentence embeddings using CLS token or max pooling
